children: Nordic Technology Group AS (NTG) will present a 45-minute company update on Tuesday, 8 September 2026, at 10:00 CET. The presentation will be hosted by Group CEO Rune Rinnan, CEO Pål Bratlie in Wavetrain Systems AS and CEO Kaare Lunde in Hammertech AS.
Presentation materials will be published at 08:00 CET the same day at www.ntechgroup.no.
The event will be held by a live webcast, with a Q&A session. Questions can be submitted throughout the stream or sent in advance to: postntg@ntechgroup.no

Nordic Technology Group AS (NTG) is the majority owner of two sensor technology companies, Hammertech AS and Wavetrain Systems AS, both offering highly competitive solutions in large global markets. Listed on Euronext Growth Oslo, NTG focuses on building long-term shareholder value through active ownership of innovative technology companies with strong growth potential. NTG targets industries where technological differentiation, scalability and sustainability are key drivers of competitive advantage.
